question: Are target records present exactly once and do all requested fields match?
case_patterns: correct control; missing row; near-miss value; wrong date; truncated text; duplicate row
independent_verifier: SQLite/provider/file exact target predicate plus protected-state diff; accessibility/screenshot confirms discoverability
androidworld_source_material: Calendar, Expense, Recipe SQLite tasks; Markor files; Contacts provider
minimum_admission_evidence: pre/post oracle snapshots; mutation confirmed; visible field review; unchanged distractors

question: Does the accepted state survive the lifecycle boundary the user expects?
case_patterns: write then reopen; rotate; background/resume; process restart; relaunch; stale restore
independent_verifier: canonical store snapshot before/after boundary; compare exact target and protected rows
androidworld_source_material: Calendar, Expense, Recipe, Markor task setup/evaluators
minimum_admission_evidence: repeatable reset; boundary event log; durable state oracle; paired control/fault

question: Did the action take effect exactly once on the intended object without collateral change?
case_patterns: no-op; wrong target; partial write; duplicate effect; collateral mutation; cancel commits
independent_verifier: before/after exact state diff with target delta and protected-state invariants
androidworld_source_material: SQLite add/delete, file move/delete, Contacts/SMS, system settings
minimum_admission_evidence: pre-state; intended delta; protected-state hashes; safe local-only side effects

question: Did the agent reach the required screen and handle back/cancel/search/return paths correctly?
case_patterns: expected transition path; Back returns to origin; cancel preserves item; search opens unique target
independent_verifier: expected activity/accessibility-tree state sequence plus independent final store state
minimum_admission_evidence: annotated state-transition contract; recorded screen/tree sequence; faulty route or app build

question: Are required controls visible, enabled, clickable, and on screen?
case_patterns: present/absent control; disabled button; occluded or off-screen target
independent_verifier: UI Automator/accessibility properties and bounds; safe hit-test for non-destructive control
androidworld_source_material: task screens and screen variation profiles
minimum_admission_evidence: control contract; screenshot/tree evidence; seeded defect; human review where tree incomplete

question: Are labels and controls legible, in bounds, and free of harmful overlap or clipping?
case_patterns: baseline vs faulted layout; portrait/landscape; keyboard/open; large text; narrow screen
independent_verifier: geometry from UI bounds plus screenshot/OCR evidence; blinded human adjudication for ambiguity
androidworld_source_material: AndroidWorld screen-variation configurations and data-entry screens
minimum_admission_evidence: pinned device profile; deterministic bounds threshold; exception rules for nesting/overlays; reviewed screenshots

question: Does displayed text accurately represent stored values, units, and required formatting?
case_patterns: correct currency/date/unit; stale label; rounded/truncated text; text differs from stored field
independent_verifier: compare DB/provider value with accessibility text and OCR/screenshot; deterministic format predicate
minimum_admission_evidence: exact stored value; expected display transform; captured UI text; locale/time-zone pinned

question: Does the app's behavior match the granted or denied Android runtime permission state?
case_patterns: permission granted; permission denied; permission revoked after grant; control whose feature remains available
independent_verifier: dumpsys package and AppOps state plus deterministic app behavior check
minimum_admission_evidence: pinned OS/API level; permission and AppOps snapshot; deterministic protected-resource behavior check

question: Does success feedback agree with the durable result?
case_patterns: success toast with dropped write; success indicator with wrong write; no toast but persisted state
independent_verifier: independent durable-state oracle plus timestamped toast/screen exposure record
androidworld_source_material: AndroidWorld add-record templates supply workflows/values, not deceptive signals
minimum_admission_evidence: same app state except feedback condition; captured signal exposure; persisted state; matched pair and random order
